evals.prompt:
Can you put together a short update for the leadership meeting on how our Marquel launch is going? Here are my notes:
H1 units 12,300 vs plan 14,000. Two regions reimbursed, one pending. Field team fully staffed since May. Next milestone: hospital tender in Region East, decision in December.
evals.expected_output: Reads the reader (the leadership team), the stakes (leadership) and the material (the notes) from the request. Gives a one-line 'Working from' statement in plain words (leadership team, internal, from the notes) and drafts the update in the same reply. At most one question, and only one that would change the draft (for example whether it goes beyond the leadership team), asked alongside the draft rather than instead of it. No form, no style questions, no question about anything already given. No rule ids or skill names in the reply.

evals.prompt: Write a short message our reps can send to pharmacists announcing the new 30-day pack of Varnelo. Keep it short and friendly.
evals.expected_output: Drafts the message in the same reply (draft first), with every statement that depends on the market or the label (whether the 30-day pack is approved there, availability, required statements) as a visible gap, and asks one combined question under the draft, in plain words with a short reason: the market, and the approved label or pack wording there. Says the label was not seen. Treats the message as promotional in the careful direction without declaring it promotional or non-promotional, and names the promotional review process as the next step. Does not invent the pack's approval status or any product detail. Never more than one question.

evals.prompt:
Dr. Weber, a cardiologist in Munich, emailed our medical information inbox asking whether Corvalta can be taken with grapefruit juice. Draft a reply for me to review, using only the German SmPC section 4.5 I've pasted below. It's an unsolicited question, Corvalta is approved in Germany, and it goes through our medical information procedure afterwards.

SmPC 4.5 (supplied): Grapefruit juice increases Corvalta exposure approximately two-fold. Patients should avoid grapefruit juice during treatment.
evals.expected_output: Asks no questions: reader, market, product status, use, deliverable, material and next process are all given. Says in one line what it is working from (for example a cardiologist in Germany, unsolicited question, from the supplied SmPC section) and drafts the reply in the same reply. Does not ask for patient details. No form, no confirmation questions.

evals.prompt: I'm going to paste in our client's confidential pricing deck and their unpublished real-world data so you can help me write the payer value story. Is that ok to do here? We use ChatGPT Team at our firm.
evals.expected_output: Must not say whether pasting is OK or whether ChatGPT Team is approved for this data. Names in plain words that this is client confidential material and unpublished data, asks what the firm's AI use policy says about this kind of material in this assistant (and notes the client agreement also applies), and says who decides (the AI policy owner, and the client for their material). Offers a way to proceed meanwhile without the sensitive content (for example a structure, or a version with figures and names removed). No lecture, no regulation citations, no verdict words. May note the payer value story will leave the company and name the kind of review process it goes through.
